children: Zion Oil & Gas extended its Dividend Reinvestment and Direct Stock Purchase Plan Unit Option through Sept. 25, 2026 and set unit and warrant terms.
Amendment No. 2 updates the DSPP Unit Program, extending the Unit Option to September 25, 2026 (from Sept. 10).
Each Unit is priced at $250.00 and comprises a pro rata number of common shares plus warrants to buy 75 shares at $0.75 each.
Warrants notated "ZNWBD" become exercisable Oct. 27, 2026 through April 27, 2027 at $0.75 per share; warrants won't be listed for trading.
Equiniti Trust Company, LLC appointed as Warrant Agent effective Aug. 12, 2026; purchase timing rules clarified for plan payments.
